result.title: Delegent: A Multi-Agent Harness That Reduces Cost without Sacrificing Performance
result.summary: Agents built on frontier language models are expensive. At every step, the frontier model re-reads its entire context and executes every subtask regardless of its difficulty. This paper explores the simple thesis that much of this cost can be removed by delegating easy subtasks to a small language model, or SLM, that runs on hardware one already owns. To test it, we build Delegent, a simple and effective agent harness built on Claude Code, in which the frontier model stays in charge of every task but hands focused subtasks, such as investigating code, running tests, and searching a corpus, to SLM subagents. Existing approaches such as cascades and model routers usually choose which model executes the entire task, whereas in Delegent, the frontier model always leads the execution and delegates easy subtasks to the SLM. No router or model is trained, so either model can be swapped freely. With the help of a 27B FP8 SLM, Delegent reduces the frontier cost of long-horizon coding by 67% and of agentic search by 59%, with no loss in task performance, and even a 2B SLM that fits on a laptop reduces the coding cost by 66%. The savings grow with the legwork that the frontier model would otherwise do itself, and a short instruction, which leaves the main coding tasks to the frontier model, accounts for most of the saving and keeps the 2B SLM from losing tasks. Code: https://github.com/castorini/delegent

AI.brief_summary: 该文构建 Delegent：一个基于 Claude Code 的 agent harness，由前沿模型始终主导任务，仅把调查代码、跑测试、检索语料等较易子任务交给本地部署的 SLM 子代理执行，无需训练路由器即可显著降低长程编码与检索任务的成本而不损性能。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按子任务难度与成本分配计算、由强模型保留决策与证据整合」的做法，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK 的成本分配与廉价子代理采集视觉证据提供类比线索，但纯文本、不涉及 latent 状态，迁移性需核查。
